<defs><marker id="ar" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="currentColor"/></marker></defs>
<g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5">

<rect x="230" y="20" width="290" height="190" rx="6"/>
<rect x="590" y="40" width="180" height="60" rx="6" stroke="var(--accent)" stroke-width="2"/>
<rect x="590" y="150" width="180" height="60" rx="6" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/>
</g>
<g font-family="IBM Plex Sans, system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="currentColor">
<text x="100" y="117" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="600">Your request</text>

<text x="375" y="44" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="600">Skill listing, sent every time</text>
<g font-family="IBM Plex Mono, monospace" font-size="11">
<text x="246" y="72">seo-audit: When the user wants</text>

<text x="246" y="110">pdf: Use this skill whenever...</text>

<text x="246" y="176">... 1,000 more names</text>
</g>
<text x="375" y="232" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill-opacity=".75">listing capped at 1% (Claude Code) or 2% (Codex) of the context window</text>
<text x="680" y="67" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="600">Load seo-audit</text>
<text x="680" y="85" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill-opacity=".75">reads the full SKILL.md</text>
<text x="680" y="177" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="600">Load nothing</text>
<text x="680" y="195" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill-opacity=".75">just starts working</text>
<text x="555" y="129" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill-opacity=".8">model</text>

</svg>
